title: 8 CTV Advertising Examples With Verified 2026 Results

facts.fact: Per Nielsen's Gauge, streaming took 48.6% of total US TV watch-time in May 2026.
facts.quote: Streaming took 48.6% of total US TV watch-time in May 2026, per Nielsen's Gauge

facts.fact: The page says Nielsen is recalibrating the Gauge report against new universe estimates, so post-recalibration shares are expected to differ from the 48.6% figure.
facts.quote: Nielsen is recalibrating the report against new universe estimates for the coming season

facts.fact: The page reports that a Volvo 35% sales lift from interactive CTV traces to a September 2018 Marketing Dive report of an Innovid study, and the page excludes this campaign from its list.
facts.quote: Volvo's 35% sales lift from interactive CTV traces to a September 2018 Marketing Dive report of an Innovid study

facts.fact: The page reports that Subway's 33% sales figure comes from August 2021 results of the "Eat Fresh Refresh" relaunch, which ran across television, digital, social, in-store, and print, and the page excludes it because no source attributes it to connected TV specifically.
facts.quote: Subway's 33% sales figure comes from the August 2021 results of the "Eat Fresh Refresh" relaunch

facts.fact: The eight campaigns on the page ran between 2024 and 2026 on Roku, The Trade Desk, Samsung, Disney, Hulu, and Reddit.
facts.quote: The eight campaigns below ran between 2024 and 2026 on Roku, The Trade Desk, Samsung, Disney, Hulu, and Reddit

facts.fact: Roku accounts for four of the eight campaigns on the page.
facts.quote: Roku accounts for four of the eight campaigns here

facts.fact: Four of the eight campaigns ran through self-serve interfaces that a two-person marketing team can operate, with no agency, insertion order, or upfront commitment.
facts.quote: Four of the eight campaigns ran through interfaces a two-person marketing team can operate

facts.fact: Shoppable overlays, pause units, and remote-activated calls to action carried real revenue in five of the campaigns on the page.
facts.quote: carried real revenue in five of these campaigns
